notes.title: Development Resumes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

To start off, I want to apologize for the lengthy absence and silence. I didn't mean to take as long as I did, however life and studies came in the way of a lot of things. However: I am now in a place where I feel that I can make some steady progress in the development of Suwarudo.

To announce this comeback, I am releasing a new update!
The new update will feature:

-Optimized Collision (Again)
-In-game Shop in the arcade
-An additional boss
-Stronger boss variations

Basically, this adds a bit more interesting elements to the arcade mode. You will be able to select a limited variation of parts when you first create your Sword in Arcade mode, but as you progress through it, you will be able to purchase new parts to enhance and customize your sword. This will enable you to get some cool and unique designs, and possibly have an easier time against the late-game enemies.
The boss is also a bit tweaked for a better fight, and an additional minor boss has been added to make the challenge more interesting.

This update is basically finished and is just waiting for release, planned on the 25th of February, and I'm already at work on the next update after that, so stay tuned for that as well, and hope you enjoy my game!

A final note though: I am still studying, and am currently writing my bachelor while developing this game, so please understand if I slow down for a moment. I have tried my best to incorporate this project into my studies to avoid delays, but life can always throw obstacles at you out of nowhere.

notes.title: Free to Play
notes.content: Hi everyone! Just want to write a formal update about the turn to free to play! Despite this change, I won't stop working on the game, it's merely because I want people to play the game, and an unfinished product isn't very enticing to purchase, so until I get some more time to continue development in an optimal speed, the game will remain f2p.
